function.description: This API allows the user to get all Native VLAN Settings at the given site. The default value of the native VLAN on the device is 1 when nothing is explicitly set.
function.name: api_getNativeVlanSettingsBySite

inheritedSiteNameHierarchy.description: The Inherited Site Name Hierarchy specifies the name hierarchy of a parent site from which Native Vlan Id is inherited.

inheritedSiteUUID.description: The Inherited Site UUID specifies the unique identifier of a parent site from which Native Vlan Id is inherited.

nativeVlanId.description: Native VLAN ID is used for any untagged frames.
